title: implement GAN training loop

atoms.evidence: lossD = -(t.log(D_x).mean() + t.log(1 - D_G_z).mean()) — explicit manual log form (not BCELoss), the discriminator's minimax term

lossD = self.training_step_discriminator(img_real, img_fake.detach()) — markdown: 'pass in the real image and the detached fake image i.e. img.detach() ... because you're training the discriminator to tell real from fake, and you don't want gradients propagating back to the generator'

self.optG = t.optim.Adam(self.model.netG.parameters(), ...); self.optD = t.optim.Adam(self.model.netD.parameters(), ...); training loop calls training_step_discriminator then training_step_generator each iteration — each has its own zero_grad/backward/step cycle
noise = t.randn(self.args.batch_size, self.args.latent_dim_size).to(device); img_fake = self.model.netG(noise) — fresh random latent batch per training iteration
if self.args.clip_grad_norm is not None: nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.netD.parameters(), self.args.clip_grad_norm); same for netG; called between loss.backward() and optD.step()/optG.step()

noise = t.randn(self.args.batch_size, self.args.latent_dim_size).to(device) — same conceptual atom as VAE eps: generate standard-normal noise of specified shape; markdown: 'fake image should be created from random noise t.randn(batch_size, latent_dim_size)'
self.model.netD(img_real), self.model.netD(img_fake), self.model.netG(noise) — explicit netG/netD wrapper-attribute access; no model.forward() ever called
self.optD.zero_grad(); ... lossD.backward(); self.optD.step() — and same triple for G; full forward/backward/step cycle

@dataclass class DCGANArgs: latent_dim_size=100, hidden_channels=field(default_factory=lambda: [128,256,512]), batch_size=64, epochs=3, lr=0.0002, betas=(0.5,0.999), clip_grad_norm=1.0, use_wandb=False
@t.inference_mode() log_samples method on Trainer; called every args.log_every_n_steps; generates samples from random noise and logs as wandb.Image
wandb.log(dict(lossD=lossD), step=self.step) inside training_step_discriminator; wandb.log(dict(lossG=lossG), step=self.step) inside training_step_generator
if self.args.use_wandb: wandb.finish() at end of train()
progress_bar = tqdm(self.trainloader, total=len(self.trainloader), ascii=True); progress_bar.set_description(f'{epoch=}, {lossD=:.4f}, {lossG=:.4f}, batches={self.step}')
